{{Top|canon=Liberators}}
The '''Mantooine Liberators''' were an early resistance group against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]], they successfully defeated an Imperial [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on the planet, confiscating the post's weapons and equipment. The Liberators were subsequently [[Battle on Mantooine/Legends|massacred]] by Imperial reinforcements striking from the [[Fest system/Legends|Fest system]]. [[Loom Carplin]] was one of the only survivors.
